## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
(Scope-add — covers the documentation gap created by introducing the new --namespace flag in task-F and the canon namespace in tasks A/C/D. Not part of original story DDs but added to ensure the new public-surface capability is discoverable per doc-router gate 2: extends existing reference doc CLAUDE.md and CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md.)

## Description
Update CLAUDE.md (Quick Reference table row for `dso ref-query`) to add the new --namespace flag. Update plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md to document:
- The --namespace=<domain> flag behavior on dso ref-query
- The --format=text|json output mode (default text)
- The canon namespace: federal-style canon entries from USWDS, GOV.UK, VA.gov, 18F, Federal Plain Language Guidelines, CDC reading-level guidance
- The precedence ladder (canon-rule > Copy Needs constraint > Users archetype > design-notes voice)
- Pointer to plugins/dso/docs/contracts/ref-query-json-output.md for the JSON schema

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] CLAUDE.md mentions --namespace flag
  Verify: grep -q -- '--namespace' CLAUDE.md
- [ ] CLAUDE.md or CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md mentions canon namespace
  Verify: grep -qE 'canon' CLAUDE.md plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md
- [ ] CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md documents federal sources
  Verify: grep -qiE 'USWDS|GOV.UK|federal plain language' plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md
- [ ] Precedence ladder documented
  Verify: grep -qE 'canon-rule.*Copy Needs|precedence' plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md
